e: Any plant that crowds out cultivated plants; (baseball) a failure by a batter or runner to reach a base safely in baseball; a very fine-grained soil that is plastic when moist but hard when fired.

A location other than here; that place / in or at that place.
The condition of being physiologically lax / the quality of being lax and neglectful.
